nodes.description: Public mapping balances tracking the token balance of every address.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used by transferFrom and written by approve.
Public totalSupply constant-initialised to 100000000000000000 * 10 ** 9.
Public token name string 'TerrierInu'.
Public token symbol string 'TERR'.
Public decimals value 9.
constructor(): mints totalSupply to msg.sender at deployment.
balanceOf(address owner) view: returns balances[owner].
transfer(address to, uint value): public balance transfer from msg.sender to 'to'.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value): public transfer using msg.sender allowance.
approve(address spender, uint value): sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address, used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender.
Unchecked arithmetic state updates in transfer: balances[to] += value and balances[msg.sender] -= value.
Unchecked arithmetic state updates in transferFrom: balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value.
Parameter 'owner' of balanceOf(address owner).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint value).
Parameter 'value' of transfer(address to, uint value).
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint value).
Parameter 'value' of approve(address spender, uint value).
allowance[from][msg.sender] >= value access-control check inside transferFrom, gating the spender's spend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial totalSupply mint.
constructor reads totalSupply to initialise the deployer balance.
constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
balanceOf indexes the balances mapping with parameter owner.
balanceOf reads state variable balances.
transfer is invoked by msg.sender and its balance is the source of funds.
transfer calls balanceOf(msg.sender) for its require check.
transfer 'to' parameter is the index of the unchecked balances[to] += value update.
transfer 'value' parameter flows into the unchecked balance arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes the unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= value update.
transfer executes the unchecked balance arithmetic operations.
unsafe arithmetic writes the balances state mapping.
transferFrom consumes the allowance granted to msg.sender as spender.
transferFrom calls balanceOf(from) for its require check.
transferFrom 'from' parameter indexes the unchecked balances[from] -= value update.
transferFrom 'to' parameter indexes the unchecked balances[to] += value update.
transferFrom 'value' parameter flows into the unchecked balance arithmetic.
msg.sender is used inside transferFrom balance updates through allowance lookup.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance arithmetic operations.
unsafe transferFrom arithmetic writes the balances state mapping.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs the allowance[from][msg.sender] >= value gate.
the allowance check reads the allowance state mapping.
approve indexes allowance with parameter spender.
approve stores parameter value into the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
approve writes the allowance state mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: owner is only used as the lookup key for balances inside balanceOf, so it can be normalised into that function node.
the 'to' parameter exists solely to index the unchecked balances[to] += value update in transfer.
the 'value' parameter is the quantity moved by the unchecked arithmetic in transfer.
the 'from' parameter is the debit index of the unchecked balances[from] -= value update.
the 'to' parameter is the credit index of the unchecked balances[to] += value update.
the 'value' parameter is the quantity moved by the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
spender only serves as the second key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
value is directly stored by approve and has no independent behaviour outside that function.
